title: Studio Interfaces: an in-progress navigation rename does not raise the beforeunload guard, so a reload or tab close silently loses it
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVkGJizGH7raJHhAvL

Filing gate: ① a product defect, a QA run clause fail (studio-authoring.held-edit-leave-guard acceptance[1]).

## Reproduction
1. Boot the showcase. Create a writable package with an app whose `navigation` has a dashboard entry labelled "QA Dash".
2. Open `/_console/studio/PKG/interfaces`, click "Edit" (nav editing opens and the "Done" chip appears), double-click the "QA Dash" entry, and type "QA Dash Lost" into the inline input.
3. Reload the page, or close the tab.
4. Expected: the browser's beforeunload prompt. Every other held or dirty Studio pillar raises it: Data picklist/lookup, Automations step, Interfaces widget, Access tick before autosave.
5. Actual: no prompt. In the page, `window.dispatchEvent(new Event('beforeunload',{cancelable:true}))` leaves `defaultPrevented` false. The reload proceeds, the label reverts to "QA Dash", and no PUT was sent.

In-app departures in the same state (pillar link, Studio home) do show the "You have unsaved changes. Leave this page anyway?" confirm, so the surface knows the edit is unsaved. Only the document-level guard is missing. Reproduced twice on fresh contexts, plus four timing cells (150 ms and 7 s). Positive control: the same probe returns true with a held Data picklist.

## Mechanism
`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (~L1585–1597) intends the leave guard to cover the "Interfaces nav editor". The in-app guard sees the nav editor's dirty state, but the beforeunload registration does not include it.
